subject.title: [Feature]: Warn when Skill Workshop update input includes proposal-only frontmatter keys

question: Should lifecycle-managed frontmatter conflicts become a structured warning in the shared Skill Workshop result contract for create, update, and revise?
rationale: The warning is useful and aligned, but its result shape becomes visible across the agent tool, CLI, Gateway, and potentially the Control UI; maintainers should confirm that public contract before implementation.

options.title: Structured shared warning
options.body: Add one service-level warning field and render it consistently across every Skill Workshop input surface.

options.title: Documentation only
options.body: Keep runtime output unchanged and clarify in the authoring documentation that supplied proposal-only keys are replaced.

recommendation.title: Structured shared warning
recommendation.body: Add one service-level warning field and render it consistently across every Skill Workshop input surface.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor is the strongest available feature-history signal for the Skill Workshop proposal lifecycle.
